title: Harden generated mesh assembly resource ownership
description: Seven-seat ownership/lifecycle review found partial-failure leaks in CreatureMeshGenerator assembly. Assemble creates the implicit Unity Mesh before mesh-asset resolution/assembly can throw, and BuildMeshAssetItem creates an owned Mesh before appearance/material/influence construction can fail. Add transactional ownership transfer so newly created meshes are destroyed when assembly aborts, while returned GeometryItems retain ownership on success. Preserve existing output semantics and platform-safe Unity destruction behavior.

comments.author: council-seven-seat-audit
comments.body: Implemented transactional ownership in CreatureMeshGenerator.Assemble and BuildMeshAssetItem. Implicit mesh ownership transfers only after insertion into GeneratedCreature; accessory mesh ownership transfers only after GeometryItem construction succeeds. Failure paths destroy untransferred meshes. No automated or Unity execution was performed in this campaign.
